mutations.because: Replacing the empty-string equality in the truncated guard with a never-matching string removes the refusal of a truncated body whose NextContinuationToken is empty: list() then follows an empty token to the second (final) page and resolves instead of rejecting, so the test that asserts list() rejects with /Refusing a truncated listing with no NextContinuationToken/ fails on its rejects.toThrow assertion line.
command: a truncated body with an empty NextContinuationToken is refused and not followed
